name: Lower Charrette Creek
about: Lower Charrette Creek drains about 15 square miles, 20% of it in St. Charles County. The land ranges from about 850 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 480 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Lake Creek and Charrette Creek. Its water flows into the Missouri River, which joins the Mississippi River at the east end of St. Charles County.
